category_title: Student with language impairment who uses loud noises and physical aggression to avoid tasks
scenario_title: Independent work on challenging worksheets without teacher attention
minimal_context: Terrance is assigned to complete a reading comprehension worksheet independently at his desk in the pull-out special education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your reading comprehension worksheet. Please complete these questions on your own at your desk while I check on the other group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet away) No, I'm not doing this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best and keep working on the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts making loud siren noises and banging his hands on the desk) Ahhhh! Woooo!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please be quiet and look at your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs his pencil and throws it at the student sitting next to him, yelling loudly) I said I'm not doing it! Look at me!
